MetadataCollectionsInSnapshot.reason: Public borrowed-snapshot constructor keeps eager validation before return and forwards the original kind selection unchanged to its common implementation. It requires a live 2 MiB parser allowance and an exact same-store transaction; SW0 snapshot tests cover eager malformed JSON errors, ownership, cancellation, aliases and retained method values.

metadataRootCursorInSnapshot.reason: Private root-only cursor defers validation solely to the typed recovery owner, which first detaches the root under logical disk quota and then performs complete validation before publication. It cannot expose a public unvalidated collection or release the caller's SQL/parser lifetime. SW27/SW33 cover exact recovery, malformed inputs, large roots and cancellation cleanup.
